# DOCXKIT_EXPORT_FAILED: Document export failed

Packaging the compiled document failed. The original cause remains available to the caller.

## What to do

1. Inspect error.cause locally to identify the failing resource.
2. Use an export format supported by the current platform and verify referenced resources.

## Problem example

```ts
// Packaging can fail when a referenced resource is invalid.
// Inspect the original cause at the export boundary.
```

## Corrected example

```ts
import { createDocx, DocxKitError, serializeDocxKitError } from 'docx-kit'

try {
  const blob = await createDocx().p('Hello').toBlob()
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof DocxKitError) {
    console.error(serializeDocxKitError(error))
    // Inspect error.cause locally when needed.
  } else {
    throw error
  }
}
```

## Common causes

- Invalid document resources or packaging failure.

## Diagnostic fields

- `code`: `EXPORT_FAILED`
- `diagnosticCode`: `DOCXKIT_EXPORT_FAILED`
- `name`: `DocxKitError`
- `docs`: https://docx-kit.ntnyq.dev/errors/docxkit_export_failed/

### Example message

```text

```
